name: default_noise_sampler (per-step white noise)
plain: The per-step noise used by ancestral samplers. Independent Gaussian per call with a generator seeded once. Draws on the latent's own device, so results can vary between GPU and CPU; it also shifts the seed by one on CPU.
math:
gen.manual_seed(seed + 1 if device is cpu else seed).
noise_sampler(σ,σ_next) = randn(x.shape, device=x.device, generator=gen). Arguments are ignored.
label: from code
surprise: Seed gets +1 only when x is on cpu (sampling.py:81), so CPU and CUDA ancestral streams differ by design even with the same generator type.
